description: This file defines a React component for an action sheet modal with navigation history, swipe interactions, and theming, used in the Notesnook project.

classes.name: ActionSheetHistoryItem
classes.description: Type representing a navigation history item with optional title and menu items.

methods.name: useHistory
methods.description: Custom hook managing navigation history stack with goBack and navigate functions.

methods.name: ActionSheetPresenter
methods.description: Main React component rendering the action sheet modal with swipe and focus management.

methods.name: ContentContainer
methods.description: Component rendering header and menu items, supporting navigation history.
